card.name: Scattered nouns in general web prose
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting; it fires on varied nouns and verbs such as drills, ejected, module, center, and jobs in general web text.

modes.label: Plural or subject nouns
modes.description: A noun that begins a new statement, such as drills or jobs, in descriptive prose.
modes.example: The kids practice<< drills>> like this every year.

modes.label: Past participles
modes.description: A verb ending like ejected or completed that closes a passive clause.
modes.example: it will be unmounted if possible, before being<< ejected>>.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese phrases meaning 'can just' or 'appropriate', which is not a clear link to these English contexts.
